notes.title: Change Notes Feb 3rd
notes.content:
new feature:
- allow keyboard standlone play 
(added space to close dialogues, h for hints and allow numlock keys as alternatives for items)

fixes:
- prevent keeping the lightning staff longer by accident (which would block progress later)
- remove duplicate default staff in lake of the dead

notes.title: Softlocks Patch

- first golem level shortened (and polished the look)
Softlock fixes (so that no menu is required to proceed):
- fixed potential softlock 36/37 (two plates not working properly)
- fixed potential softlock in 49 (key to door didnt work when steam connection was lost)
- fixed potential softlock 57/58 (saved afer ogre death on wrong field)
- fixed potential softlock in 93 (elinar not moving)
